patternCandidates.name: Pre-verification rules nudge (bottom sheet before a capture)
patternCandidates.whenToUse: Captain triggers an action (going ON DUTY) that requires a selfie/biometric check; explain rules + consequences before opening the camera.
patternCandidates.structure: Scrim over home > close X floating above sheet top-right > Bottom Sheet: full-bleed hero image (captain doing the action, light-blue bg) > H title > 2 bullet rules > tinted error 'Note' box (icon+label header, body) for consequence > [optional consent checkbox row with Privacy Policy link] > full-width primary CTA 'Start'
patternCandidates.variations: Hero swaps by segment (male / women captain / Bike Pink); v1 used check-icon list + 'I'm Ready' (770:6314); consent row added 2026
patternCandidates.conflicts: v1 uses another library's CTA/Check/Spacer; copy drifted ('Quick selfie verification' / 'Quick Selfie Verification' / 'Quick face verification'); Note box with/without icon header.

patternCandidates.name: Consent-gated primary CTA
patternCandidates.whenToUse: Legal consent is mandatory before proceeding.
patternCandidates.structure: Checkbox + multi-line legal text with inline link directly above full-width primary; primary disabled (grey) until ticked
patternCandidates.conflicts: Default state of checkbox not specified (ticked shown first).

patternCandidates.name: Blocking/suspension comm bottom sheet
patternCandidates.whenToUse: An action is blocked for a time period because of a failed check (e.g. 3 failed face auths -> orders blocked N hours).
patternCandidates.structure: Scrim over home > X > Bottom Sheet: left-aligned circular illustration with red 'no-entry' badge > bold title stating block + duration ('Orders blocked for 2 hours') > one-line reason ('As face verification failed 3 times') > full-width primary 'OK'
patternCandidates.conflicts: Re-shown each time captain tries ON DUTY; no persistent indicator on home (old design had red home banner, rejected). Duration should be parameterised (%1$d in Hindi).

patternCandidates.name: Third-party verification hand-off (vendor SDK)
patternCandidates.whenToUse: Biometric capture done by HyperVerge SDK.
patternCandidates.structure: App nudge sheet -> SDK 'Take a Selfie' intro -> OS camera permission -> oval face capture -> processing -> success / 'Face verification failed' full-page -> back to home with result sheet
patternCandidates.conflicts: Vendor screens use purple CTA and different type; app owns only the before/after sheets.

patternCandidates.name: Document camera capture with preview, crop, rotate
patternCandidates.structure: Dark full-screen: header (back + doc name; in preview adds Rotate & Crop icon-text actions right) > live camera with optional card bounding box > bottom panel title + helper > Gallery (left) + circular shutter (centre). Preview: image card + Retake (outline) / Submit (primary yellow) 50/50. Crop: corner handles + 'Done ✓' pill. Gallery images open in crop by default.
patternCandidates.conflicts: Header is a dark variant from another library, not Runway InternalPageHeader.

missingComponents.name: CameraCapture / CameraPreview chrome
missingComponents.description: Dark full-screen camera with doc-name header, bounding-box overlay, title/helper panel, Gallery + shutter; preview with Rotate/Crop actions and Retake/Submit pair; crop mode with Done pill.

missingComponents.name: NoteBox / Inline alert (error tint)
missingComponents.description: Red-tinted rounded box with optional icon + 'Note' header and body text, used inside sheets for consequences.

missingComponents.name: Consent checkbox row with link
missingComponents.description: Checkbox + multi-line legal text with inline underlined link; drives CTA disabled state.

missingComponents.name: Status illustration with badge
missingComponents.description: Circular light-blue illustration with red no-entry badge for blocked states.

missingComponents.name: Home off-duty empty state
missingComponents.description: Home built from non-Runway components (HOME SCREEN SWITCH, on duty, Today's Earnings Accordian).

Which consent copy is final (1405:838 vs 1471:599 vs 1471:750)? Is the checkbox ticked or unticked by default?
Blocked duration: EN frames hardcode '2 hours' while Hindi uses %1$d — confirm it is configurable (kitchen text says X configurable hours).
Reason line: 'Face verification failed 3 times' (Apr 2026 page) vs 'As face verification failed 3 times' (Feb + localisation) — which is final?
Should a blocked captain see a persistent home indicator (countdown) rather than only a re-shown sheet on ON DUTY tap?
